Arasendra
II 1555-1602 A. D. Ruler of Sodā (Sodā Samasthānam) in Gorāṣṭradeśa, east of Gokarṇa in Konkan. Mādhava Sarasvatī wrote a. Sodā in his time the Sarvadarśanakaumudī etc. (MT. 3085 (a.). The details of the date of the passing away of Mādhava Sarasvatī given in MT. 3085 (b) may be taken to correspond to 14-5-1560 A. D.
See Epi. Ind. XXXIV. (1961) p.. 205-6, Honnehall ins. of Arasappa [Page369-b] Nayaka II is d. 1555 A. D. an. ARE. 1939-40, no. E-46 is his Karasvalli ins. of 1602 A. D.
See also Bombay Gazetteer XV. ii. 1883. p.. 120, 266, 347; J. of the Bomb. Uni. XXIX. i-iv. p.. 1-3.
Arasappa is said to have patronised also Akalaṅka a. of Karṇāṭa Śabdānuśāsana (1604 A. D.).
